definitions.explanation: The natural desire or craving for food.

examples.japanese: ⟦{風邪|かぜ}→風邪：02188_kaze⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}いて→引く：01978_hiku⟧{食欲|しょくよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: I have no appetite because I caught a cold.
Fall is said to be the season of appetite.
examples.notes: Common Japanese expression associating autumn with good eating

examples.japanese: ⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧{食欲|しょくよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: After exercising, I developed an appetite.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{食欲|しょくよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちて→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦しまう→しまう：03064_shimau⟧。
examples.english: When hot days continue, my appetite drops.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{治|なお}って→治る：19598_naoru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{食欲|しょくよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{戻|もど}って→戻る：01117_modoru⟧、⟦{何|なに}→何：00498_nani⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べても→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦{美味|おい}しく→美味しい：00740_oishii⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧⟦よう→よう：01114_you⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: After recovering from my illness, my appetite returned and everything I eat tastes delicious.

notes:
{食欲|しょくよく} specifically refers to appetite for food.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {食欲|しょくよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have an appetite)
- {食欲|しょくよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to have no appetite)
- {食欲|しょくよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (appetite returns/develops)
- {食欲|しょくよく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦そそる→そそる：10359_sosoru⟧ (to whet one's appetite)
- {食欲|しょくよく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (appetite decreases)
- {食欲|しょくよく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{秋|あき}→秋：02276_aki⟧ (autumn, the season of appetite)
